svg.text: Knitting chart — worked in the round
Gauge: 5 stitches × 7 rows = 1 in (2.5 cm) in stockinette.
Cells are drawn at that gauge (1.4× wider than tall), so the bean knits up in true proportion.
Read every round right to left (←); stitch 1 is at the bottom right.
The chart’s wide cells keep it this shape.
1 in wide = 1 in tall, so cells are 1.4× wide.
